scripts.interfacectl:build: cd tools/interfacectl && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build
scripts.validate:ci: pnpm run interfacectl:build && node scripts/print-provenance.mjs && node tools/interfacectl/packages/interfacectl-cli/dist/index.js validate --workspace-root . --contract ./contracts/surfaces.web.contract.json
scripts.cli:where:local: node -e "const pkg = require('./tools/interfacectl/packages/interfacectl-cli/package.json'); const {execSync} = require('child_process'); console.log('=== Local Workspace CLI ==='); try { const bin = require('path').resolve(process.cwd(), 'tools/interfacectl/packages/interfacectl-cli/dist/index.js'); console.log('Binary:', bin); } catch { } try { const version = execSync('node tools/interfacectl/packages/interfacectl-cli/dist/index.js --version', {encoding: 'utf8', cwd: process.cwd()}).trim(); console.log('Version:', version); } catch { console.log('Version:', pkg.version); } try { const sha = execSync('git rev-parse HEAD', {encoding: 'utf8', cwd: 'tools/interfacectl'}).trim(); console.log('interfacectl Git SHA:', sha); } catch { console.log('Git SHA: not a git repo'); }"
scripts.cli:where:ci: node -e "const pkg = require('./tools/interfacectl/packages/interfacectl-cli/package.json'); const path = require('path'); console.log('=== CI/Prod Workspace CLI ==='); console.log('Build status: CLI built from tools/interfacectl'); console.log('Binary:', path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'tools/interfacectl/packages/interfacectl-cli/dist/index.js')); try { const version = require('child_process').execSync('node tools/interfacectl/packages/interfacectl-cli/dist/index.js --version', {encoding: 'utf8', cwd: process.cwd()}).trim(); console.log('Version:', version); } catch { console.log('Version:', pkg.version); } try { const sha = require('child_process').execSync('git rev-parse HEAD', {encoding: 'utf8', cwd: 'tools/interfacectl'}).trim(); console.log('interfacectl Git SHA:', sha); } catch { }"
scripts.dev:all: pnpm --filter surfaces-web dev & pnpm --filter surfaceops-web dev & pnpm --filter interfacectl-web dev & pnpm --filter surfaces-dev dev
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @surfaces/ui type-check && pnpm --filter surfaces-web type-check && pnpm --filter surfaceops-web type-check && pnpm --filter interfacectl-web type-check && pnpm --filter surfaces-dev type-check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter surfaceops-web test && pnpm run test:scripts
